formula_zh: (14期最高 - 收盘) / (14期最高 - 14期最低)
intuition_en: 14h Williams %R: (HH14-close)/(HH14-LL14). Momentum oscillator, 0-1 scale. 0=at high, 1=at low.
intuition_zh: 14小时威廉%R：(14期最高-收盘)/(14期最高-14期最低)。动量振荡器，0-1范围。0=在最高点，1=在最低点。
expected_direction_explanation_en: Negative direction: Williams %R near 0 = overbought (at 14h high), expecting pullback.
expected_direction_explanation_zh: 负向：威廉%R接近0=超买（在14小时高点），预期回调。
known_limitations_en: Similar to RSI but inverted scale. Can stay at extremes in trending markets.
known_limitations_zh: 类似RSI但范围反转。趋势市中可能长期处于极端值。
horizon_notes_en: Lookback window: 14 bars. Evaluation covers 1h/4h/24h/72h horizons.
horizon_notes_zh: 回溯窗口：14根K线。评价覆盖1h/4h/24h/72h视野。
status_explanation_en: Status: DIAGNOSTIC_PROBE. Diagnostic probe — not yet promoted to active signal.
status_explanation_zh: 状态：DIAGNOSTIC_PROBE。诊断探针——尚未升级为活跃信号。

review_subreason_zh: 方向语义需复核；不要人工预设正负方向。
